@@ -1356,6 +1350,16 @@ class Parameter(object):
                      order of processing.
     :param envvar: a string or list of strings that are environment variables

     def value_from_envvar(self, ctx):

message.content: When an environment variable is set to an empty string (e.g., `MYPATH=''`), Click incorrectly treats it as if the variable has a value, rather than ignoring it as if the variable were not set.
